content.short: OKX Wallet is a multi-chain Web3 wallet by OKX supporting 70+ blockchains including Mantle, with built-in DEX, bridge, and DeFi discovery.
content.description: OKX Wallet is a comprehensive self-custodial Web3 wallet developed by OKX, one of the world's largest crypto exchanges. The wallet supports over 70 blockchains including Mantle and provides a full suite of Web3 tools including a built-in DEX aggregator, cross-chain bridge, NFT gallery, and DeFi yield discovery. Users benefit from OKX's deep institutional liquidity when swapping through the wallet's integrated DEX. Available as a browser extension and mobile app, OKX Wallet offers a seamless gateway to the Mantle ecosystem.
